name: Bookvara
tagline: Scheduling and payments software that keeps appointments, clients, staff, and checkout in one place for service businesses.
description: Bookvara (Vara) gives service businesses one system for appointments, clients, staff schedules, catalog, and payments instead of separate tools for calendars and checkout.

coverImage.alt: Bookvara calendar day view with staff columns and booked appointments

screenshots.alt: Bookvara client booking flow selecting date and time for a service

problem: Service businesses often pay for one tool for booking, another for payments, and another for client notes, which leads to double-booking and slow checkout.
approach: Ship a single operational surface for calendars, services, clients, staff availability, and payments designed for how service businesses actually work.
solution: An all-in-one SaaS platform where clients book online, staff schedules stay live, and payments happen in the same product as appointments.
features: Staff calendar with day, week, and month views
Online booking with service duration and pricing
Built-in payments for cards and digital wallets
Reporting for revenue and appointment performance
architecture: Multi-tenant SaaS with shared booking, client, catalog, and payment models so appointments and checkout stay on one system of record.
